scientific.integrity: The capped SPS update reduces exactly to a uniformly contractive random affine system. Its stationary mean and variance follow from exact distributional fixed-point equations, and the cap regimes follow by whether each curvature-dependent step is capped.
limitations: The theorem is one-dimensional and assumes uniform independent component sampling.
It uses exact component minima and fixed positive SPS parameters.
The uncapped curvature-blind target is prior-covered; the novelty-bearing part is the finite-cap curvature-clipping phase diagram and stationary law.
Multidimensional noncommuting Hessians require a different analysis.

title: Exact curvature-clipping phase diagram for capped SPS on scalar quadratics
